description.zh:
生命周期策略描述。

格式：
长度为3-64个字符，必须以字母开头，可以包含英文字母、数字、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。
>仅 CPFS 智算版支持。
description.en:
The description of the lifecycle policy.

The description must be 3 to 64 characters long and must start with a letter. It can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

> This parameter is supported only for CPFS for AI file systems.
The ID of the file system.

description.zh:
生命周期策略的 ID。
>CPFS 智算版 文件系统必填。
description.en:
The ID of the lifecycle policy.

> This parameter is required for CPFS for AI file systems.

description.zh: 生命周期管理策略关联目录的绝对路径。
description.en: The absolute paths of the directories to which the lifecycle policy applies.

description.zh:
文件数据取回规则，最多配置 1 个。
>仅 CPFS 智算版文件系统支持。
description.en:
The retrieval rule for files. You can specify only one retrieval rule.

> This parameter is supported only for CPFS for AI file systems.

description.zh:
规则的属性，取值：
- RetrieveType:  取回方式
description.en:
The rule attribute. Valid value:

- `RetrieveType`: The retrieval method.

description.zh:
规则的阈值，取值：
- RetrieveType
    - AfterVisit： LifecyclePolicyType=Auto 支持，代表尽力 recall on visit
    - All:  LifecyclePolicyType=OnDemand 支持，代表取回所有
description.en:
The retrieval method. Valid values:

- If `Attribute` is set to `RetrieveType`:

  - `AfterVisit`: Retrieves data on a best-effort basis after a file is accessed. This value is valid only when `LifecyclePolicyType` is `Auto`.

  - `All`: Retrieves all data. This value is valid only when `LifecyclePolicyType` is `OnDemand`.

description.zh:
分级存储类型。
- InfrequentAccess：低频存储（默认值）。
- Archive：归档存储。
description.en:
The storage tier.

- `InfrequentAccess`: The Infrequent Access storage tier. This is the default value.

- `Archive`: The Archive storage tier.

description.zh:
文件数据转储规则，最多配置 1 个。

>仅 CPFS 智算版文件系统的 LifecyclePolicyType=Auto 时支持
description.en:
The transition rule for files. You can specify only one transition rule.

> This parameter is supported only for CPFS for AI file systems when `LifecyclePolicyType` is set to `Auto`.

description.zh:
规则的属性。

取值：
- Atime: 文件的访问时间。
description.en:
The rule attribute.

Valid value:

- `Atime`: The last access time of a file.

description.zh:
规则的阈值。

取值：
- 当 Attribute 为 Atime 时，表示多少天未访问的文件，取值范围[1,365]
description.en:
The rule threshold.

Valid value:

- If `Attribute` is set to `Atime`, this parameter specifies the number of days since a file was last accessed. The value must be between 1 and 365.

title.zh: 更新生命周期管理策略的规则

example.unifiedCli: aliyun nas update-lifecycle-policy --file-system-id bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64y00000 --storage-type InfrequentAccess --lifecycle-policy-id lsp-bp1234567890ab0000 --description Lifecycle_policy_description --paths /path1 --transit-rules Attribute=Atime Threshold=3 --retrieve-rules Attribute=RetrieveType Threshold=All --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun nas UpdateLifecyclePolicy --region cn-hangzhou --StorageType InfrequentAccess --Description Lifecycle_policy_description --TransitRules.1.Threshold 3 --RetrieveRules.1.Attribute RetrieveType --LifecyclePolicyId 'lsp-bp1234567890ab0000' --RetrieveRules.1.Threshold All --TransitRules.1.Attribute Atime --FileSystemId 'bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64y00000' --Paths.1 '/path1'
